readout_other: red blood cell counts in CSF and deep cervical lymph nodes; immunohistochemistry (IBA1, GFAP, Fluoro-Jade C, CD68, GAL-3, P2RY12, AQP4); spatial transcriptomics; corner turn test; grip strength; brain water content; survival
direction_notes: Ultrasound debris clearance (UDC) increased red blood cell clearance to deep cervical lymph nodes, reduced neuroinflammation markers and neuronal degeneration, and improved behaviour and survival after intracerebral hemorrhage; neuronal excitation or inhibition was not assessed.
safety_notes: Intracranial temperature measured with a thermocouple (peak change -0.5 +/- 0.2 C); k-Wave simulation indicated no substantive parenchymal heating; protocol stated to satisfy FDA guidelines (MI 0.9).
